items.question: What services does Luciana offer as an agency?
items.answer: We offer social media management, Meta and Google Ads, SEO, web design, email marketing, content strategy and more. All integrated under one strategy.

items.question: How does a collaboration with Luci Shows work?
items.answer: Together, we define the goals and details of the collaboration, produce the content and agree on publication. Each collaboration includes a results report.

items.question: How long does it take to see results?
items.answer: Timelines depend on the service, your industry and your business’s starting point. Advertising can provide data in the first few weeks, while organic growth and search engine rankings usually take several months. We track progress and refine the strategy throughout, without guaranteeing specific results within a fixed timeframe.

items.question: What's the minimum budget to work with you?
items.answer: Our most accessible pack starts in the €300-600/month range. For influencer campaigns, the budget varies based on content type and desired reach.

items.question: Do you work with international brands?
items.answer: Yes! We work with brands from Spain, Europe, Latin America, and the USA. Our content adapts to each market and audience.

items.question: What metrics do your reports include?
items.answer: Each report includes reach, impressions, engagement rate, follower growth, web traffic, conversions, and estimated ROI for each campaign.

items.question: How do we start working together?
items.answer: First, we talk to you to understand your business, goals and target audience. We then present a proposal with the services and terms. Once accepted, we organise the materials we need, define the strategy and agree on a work schedule.

items.question: Can I cancel the service at any time?
items.answer: There is no minimum-term commitment. For monthly services, you can cancel by giving at least 15 days’ notice before the next renewal, with no cancellation penalty. One-off projects follow the terms agreed in their quotation.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: The initial setup fee is paid in two parts: 50% at the start and the remaining 50% when that phase is completed. Monthly services are paid in advance. All payments are made by bank transfer and accompanied by an invoice. Fees and terms for one-off projects and collaborations are detailed in the proposal before work begins.

items.question: Can I see examples of previous work?
items.answer: Of course! During our initial meeting we'll share our complete portfolio with case studies and real metrics from previous campaigns.

items.question: Do you offer one-time projects or only monthly?
items.answer: We offer both. Packs are monthly, but we also do one-time projects like web design, specific campaigns, or individual collaborations with Luci.

items.question: What sets Luciana apart from other agencies?
items.answer: We combine professional agency services with the power of a +5M-follower influencer. That means strategy + real reach in a single partner.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: In compliance with Law 34/2002 (LSSI-CE) and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), we inform you about the use of cookies on this website.

what.heading: 1. What Are Cookies?
what.text: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, tablet, or phone) when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember your actions and preferences over a period of time, so you don't have to re-enter them each time you visit.

technical.heading: Technical Cookies (Necessary)
technical.text: These are essential for the website to function. They enable navigation and the use of the different options or services offered.

analytics.heading: Analytics Cookies
analytics.text: These allow us to count the number of users and perform statistical measurement and analysis of website usage. Your browsing is analyzed to improve the range of products and services offered.

thirdParty.heading: 3. Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.text: This website may include embedded content from third parties (e.g., Instagram or TikTok videos). These services may install their own cookies. We recommend consulting each provider's cookie policy:
items: Instagram (Meta Platforms, Inc.) — Meta's cookie policy
TikTok (ByteDance Ltd.) — TikTok's cookie policy

manage.heading: 4. How to Manage and Disable Cookies
manage.text: You can configure your browser to accept, reject, or delete cookies. Here's how to do it in the main browsers:
items: Google Chrome: Settings → Privacy and Security → Cookies
Mozilla Firefox: Options → Privacy & Security → Cookies
Safari: Preferences → Privacy → Cookies
Microsoft Edge: Settings → Cookies and Site Permissions
manage.note: Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of some features of this website.

updates.heading: 5. Updates to This Policy
updates.text: This cookie policy may be updated at any time to adapt to regulatory changes or modifications to our website. We recommend reviewing it periodically. Any significant changes will be communicated through a visible notice on the website.
